source.title: 30 MIN CALORIE KILLER HIIT WORKOUT - Full Body Cardio, No Equipment, No Repeat

notes: Checked against the video: the warm-up and the end by eye (the Next: bar names the move that comes next, here throughout each 30 s warm-up move), the rest from the timer-based draft read through the Next: box. Six 30 s warm-up moves from 14 s, then 45 s of work with 15 s of rest; where a Next: bar hides the last seconds of a work the draft read it short, so those pairs are set back to 45/15. Moves are named only in a black Next: <move> bar top left. Sections left out: none of the video's parts is named on screen.
